Front-end focuses on interface technical implementation, while back-end focuses on technical frameworks, services, and data; the two internal lines may be combined in one position.
Communicate requirement priorities and technical issues with user managers, design, development, network, or hosting staff, and verify the agreement before changing the implementation.

The ONet CI interests and Zone Three are the US framework; the education survey and BLS job differences must be kept separate, and a Chinese undergraduate internship sample does not set a unified entry requirement.
Computer work requires attention to detail, continuous learning, and team communication; the US hours survey is not a Chinese hours requirement, and W30 does not access real accounts or systems.
Front-end implementation and back-end services are the internal task focuses, and both require reviewable requirements, code, and tests.

Insufficient evidence: no representative AI adoption, net time saving, rework defect, or replacement causality for the detailed web development occupation was obtained. The arXiv2507.09089v2 abstract was read: a randomized experiment in which 16 experienced open-source project developers completed 246 tasks found that allowing then-current AI increased completion time by 19%; the sample tools and period are specific, so this cannot be extrapolated to all web developers, and it is not asserted that no research exists. The full paper was not read.

values: W30 materials: fictional quantity validation

Paper-only requirement: accept only integer quantities q with 1<=q<=3. Accept or reject is the only result, with no real product payment involved. The R0 implemented rule: q is an integer and 1<=q<3. Five cases: A=0 expected reject, B=1 accept, C=3 accept, D=4 reject, E=2.5 reject.
Wrong draft: "All five R0 cases meet expectations, 100% pass, the system is fully secure and compatible, and it can be released directly."
Task: find the counterexample and give separate feedback

First work through accept or reject for each case under R0, compare with the problem's expectations, and calculate consistent cases / total cases. Person A keeps the five cases and the requirement unchanged, fixes only the R0 upper-bound condition, rechecks, and withdraws the comprehensive guarantee.

Person B is an independent variant: keep the original R0 rule and A to E unchanged, add F=-1 expected to be rejected, work out the six-case consistency rate, and state whether the original error is resolved. Person B does not inherit Person A's fix.
Reference answer: boundaries and ratios

The R0 gives reject, accept, reject, reject, reject in order, with only C differing from expectation, so 4/5=80%. Person A changes it to integer and 1<=q<=3, giving reject, accept, accept, reject, reject, so 5/5=100%; this is consistent only for the problem's five cases, and the security, compatibility, and release guarantees are withdrawn.

Person B uses the original R0, where F=-1 is rejected consistently with the expectation, while A to E are unchanged and C still fails, giving 5/6≈83.3%. The ratio change comes from one added case, not a fix, an AI efficiency gain, or full coverage; real execution, interface, permission, performance, and compatibility are all unknown.
W30 | Complete simulated handover and deliverable boundaries

Recorder: trainee; intended reviewer: simulated development and testing lead. The requirement accepts only integers with 1<=q<=3. The R0 is integer and 1<=q<3, and A0/B1/C3/D4/E2.5 expects reject, accept, accept, reject, reject; R0 actually gives reject, accept, reject, reject, reject on paper, with C failing, so 4/5=80%. Person A changes only to <=3 while keeping the five cases, giving 5/5=100%, and withdraws all security, compatibility, and release guarantees. Person B independently keeps the original R0 and the five cases, adds F=-1 expected to be rejected and rejected on paper, giving 5/6≈83.3% with C still failing; the ratio change comes from one added case, not a fix or an AI efficiency gain.

Unknowns: real execution, interface agreements, permissions, performance, device and browser compatibility, and conditions not given such as empty strings. These are to be verified by the actual development, testing, and data responsible persons within the project scope; this simulation was not sent and has no confirmation. Your contribution is the rule card, the case-by-case comparison, the Person A and Person B version notes, and the unknown reflection, all paper reasoning, with no real product payment, account data, or server, and is not called actual testing, security certification, or a release permission.
